ns2:section.sectionText: Additive manufacturing fundamentals, how and why to design products using additive manufacturing, theory, and practice of product innovation, modern product realization. This course is restricted to graduate students from the College of Engineering and the College of Business. Students in Industrial Design can also register with approval override. Please contact the MechSE Undergraduate Programs Office (mechse-ug-advise@illinois.edu).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to College of Business or Engineering. Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
